title: TMEM106B risk converges on C-terminal fragment homeostasis: genetics, mechanisms and therapy
title_zh: TMEM106B风险聚焦于C端片段稳态：遗传学、机制与治疗
abstract: Abstract TMEM106B is a genetic modifier influencing susceptibility to multiple neurodegenerative disorders, including frontotemporal lobar degeneration with TDP-43 pathology (FTLD-TDP), Alzheimer’s disease, Parkinson’s disease, and limbic-predominant age-related TDP-43 encephalopathy, as well as contributing to healthy brain aging and neuronal reserve. The gene harbours single nucleotide polymorphisms and structural variants that define risk and protective haplotypes, and despite extensive efforts to identify the functional variant within these haplotypes, consensus remains elusive. In this review, we synthesize current knowledge of TMEM106B genetics from human cohorts and mechanistic studies, highlighting how variants may influence its regulatory network and protein levels, with an emphasis on its aggregation-prone C-terminal domain. We further integrate evidence on the roles of TMEM106B within the endo-lysosomal system and beyond, including insights into protein structure, posttranslational modifications, interactors, proteolytic processing, and fibril formation. These findings are contextualized using data from mouse and induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) models, highlighting current gaps in the available models and the advances required to study its functions and cleavage. Finally, we explore therapeutic strategies targeting TMEM106B, focusing on modulation of expression, specific functional pathways, and fibril formation.
abstract_zh: 摘要 TMEM106B 是一种遗传修饰因子，影响多种神经退行性疾病的易感性，包括 TDP-43 病理的额颞叶脑变性（FTLD-TDP）、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病以及以边缘系统为主的年龄相关 TDP-43 脑病，并有助于健康脑老化和神经元储备。该基因携带单核苷酸多态性和结构变异，定义了风险和保护性单倍型，尽管已广泛努力识别这些单倍型中的功能变异，但共识仍未达成。在本综述中，我们综合了来自人类队列和机制研究的 TMEM106B 遗传学现有知识，重点阐述变异如何影响其调控网络和蛋白水平，特别是其易聚集的 C 端结构域。我们进一步整合了 TMEM106B 在内吞-溶酶体系统及其之外的作用证据，包括对蛋白结构、翻译后修饰、相互作用蛋白、蛋白水解处理和纤维形成的见解。通过小鼠和诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）模型的数据，这些发现被置于背景中，突出当前模型的不足以及研究其功能和切割所需的进展。最后，我们探讨针对 TMEM106B 的治疗策略，聚焦于表达调控、特定功能通路和纤维形成的干预。
